note: The Valerius family tree. A relative appears once the story calls $ do kin("id") (and $ do kin("id", "dead") to change their status). person ties a member to content/people.json for names and pronouns. parents and partner list other member ids. label is a word or a table by gender. quick sets the status a quick start gives them when it skips their book (a status word, or true for living); book sessions set it. The et_ members are for the developer sample chapter.
